quotes.title: GJ 1132
quotes.card: GJ 1132 is a small red dwarf star 41.1 light-years away from Earth in the constellation Vela.
quotes.introduction: In 2015, it was revealed to have a hot rocky Earth-sized planet orbiting it every 1.6 days.

notes: GJ 1132 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
